source: Insureon moving company insurance cost page
sample_definition: Median cost of policies purchased by moving businesses that apply for quotes through Insureon; sample size and number of trucks per insured business are not published on the cited page.

commercial_auto.notes: Not per truck; depends on number and value of trucks, annual revenue, use frequency, local/long-distance operations, driver records, coverage and deductibles.

general_liability.notes: Business-level liability, not vehicle-specific; bailee/care-custody-control coverage may be needed for customer property.

workers_compensation.notes: Payroll- and workforce-dependent; do not classify as truck-only insurance or divide per truck without payroll/exposure data.

not_included_or_separate: Cargo / bailee coverage and customer-goods liability require separate attention; the source page notes additional coverage beyond commercial auto.
Physical damage, umbrella/excess, hired/non-owned auto and on-hook/towing policies may be separate.
These are policy medians among Insureon applicants, not a representative census, guaranteed quotes, or universal market averages.
model_use: External moving-industry insurance sanity check only. Commercial auto is the most directly relevant policy, but cannot be converted to per-mile/per-truck cost without fleet size and annual mileage for the same insured businesses. General liability and workers compensation belong in company overhead / labor cost allocation, not direct truck fuel cost.
